thermokarst_expansion.alt: A grassy permafrost bank has collapsed into blocks above a broad muddy thaw slump.
thermokarst_expansion.caption: Thawing permafrost on Herschel Island, Canada, photographed in 2013. Blocks of turf have broken away from the retreating ground edge into the wet slump below.

permafrost_thaw.alt: Exposed frozen ground beneath a grassy, eroding riverbank at Birch Creek.
permafrost_thaw.caption: An exposed ice lens beneath the riverbank at Birch Creek, Alaska. The source documents summer melting and slumping at this site.

glacial_lake_failure_risk.alt: Grey-green glacial lake below an ice-covered mountain valley in Nepal.
glacial_lake_failure_risk.caption: Imja Lake meets Imja Glacier in Nepal, 2011. This shows a glacial-lake setting; an outburst is not shown.

glacier_calving_events.alt: A cloud of spray rises as ice breaks from the blue face of Hubbard Glacier.
glacier_calving_events.caption: Ice calving from Hubbard Glacier, Alaska, 2017.

sea_ice_season_loss.alt: Researchers and equipment on a broad snow-covered sheet of Arctic sea ice.
sea_ice_season_loss.caption: A temporary research camp on Arctic sea ice at the North Pole, 1990. This field photograph does not show a change over time.

peak_glacier_runoff_passage.alt: A bright blue meltwater stream curves through a white, cracked glacier surface.
peak_glacier_runoff_passage.caption: Meltwater winding across a glacier surface. This illustrates the water pathway, not a measured runoff trend or downstream water supply.
peak_glacier_runoff_passage.credit: Eric Kilby from Somerville, MA, USA

coral_bleaching.alt: Pale white brain coral among darker reef outcrops underwater.
coral_bleaching.caption: Bleached coral at Cheeca Rocks, Florida Keys, July 2023. This illustrates vulnerable reef habitat; structural collapse and fragmentation are not shown.

antarctic_shelf_instability.alt: An aerial photograph of fractured Antarctic ice beside dark open water.
antarctic_shelf_instability.caption: The Larsen Ice Shelf seen from NASA’s DC-8 during a 2004 flight. This shows the ice-shelf setting, not a current rate of retreat.

mangrove_buffer_loss.alt: Dense green mangroves border shallow coastal water and a sandbar.
mangrove_buffer_loss.caption: Mangroves beside a tidal shoreline in Ciudad del Carmen, Mexico. This illustrates the habitat; habitat loss is not shown.

palm_oil_canopy_clearance.alt: Rows of oil palms surround irregular fragments of taller forest canopy.
palm_oil_canopy_clearance.caption: Oil-palm plantations alongside forest fragments in Costa Rica, photographed from the air.

seagrass_meadow_decline.alt: A scuba diver swims above a green underwater seagrass meadow.
seagrass_meadow_decline.caption: A diver over a seagrass meadow in the Florida Keys, 2023. This illustrates the habitat, not a decline measurement.

cement_concrete.alt: Tall industrial silos and conveyor structures at a cement plant.
cement_concrete.caption: The Exshaw cement plant, photographed in 2015. This shows conventional production infrastructure; emissions and low-carbon production are not demonstrated.

food_waste.alt: Overhead view of a large green bin filled with discarded fruit, vegetables, and packaged mushrooms.
food_waste.caption: Discarded fruit and vegetables in a retailer's waste container, photographed in 2013.

mountain_pass_avalanches.alt: A broad avalanche scar and deposited snow on a steep mountain slope.
mountain_pass_avalanches.caption: An avalanche deposit below Griankopf in the Rojental valley, South Tyrol, Italy.

airport_operational_disruption.alt: A passenger aircraft stands beside an airport jet bridge in Mumbai.
airport_operational_disruption.caption: A passenger aircraft at Mumbai airport. This shows aviation infrastructure; a climate-related disruption or emissions trend is not shown.

coastal_erosion.alt: A pipe protrudes from a collapsed sandy coastal bank beneath a steep eroded edge.
coastal_erosion.caption: Coastal erosion at Happisburgh, England, has exposed a pipe in a broken bank. The loss of supporting ground is visible at human scale.

shipping.alt: Cargo ships, container stacks and loading cranes on a long port island.
shipping.caption: An aerial view of Miami’s container port. This shows shipping infrastructure, not congestion, heat disruption, or fuel emissions.

active_mobility.alt: Two people ride bicycles in a protected cycle lane next to city traffic.
active_mobility.caption: People cycle in a separated lane beside buses and cars. Walking and cycling can replace some motorized trips when routes are connected, practical and accessible.

dust_storm_frequency.alt: A dense wall of brown airborne dust approaches a rural road.
dust_storm_frequency.caption: A dust storm approaches Cimarron County, Oklahoma, October 2020. This documents one event, not its frequency.

harmful_algal_blooms.alt: Green algal streaks spread across the water around a small boat.
harmful_algal_blooms.caption: A harmful algal bloom in western Lake Erie, July 2018. This documents visible bloom water, not a nutrient concentration measurement.
harmful_algal_blooms.credit: Zachary Haslick / Aerial Associates Photography, via NOAA GLERL

ice_algae_pigmentation.alt: Pink-red algae colour a patch of melting snow.
ice_algae_pigmentation.caption: Pink snow caused by cold-loving algae in Upper Meadow, Lassen Volcanic National Park, California.

cryoconite_hole_expansion.alt: A circular dark patch sits within a shallow hole in white glacier ice.
cryoconite_hole_expansion.caption: A sediment-darkened cryoconite hole on Taylor Glacier, Antarctica, 2014. One hole is shown; its expansion over time is not measured here.

kelp_forest_collapse.alt: Tall brown kelp stems rise through blue underwater light.
kelp_forest_collapse.caption: Wild kelp at Strawberry Rocks, Oudekraal, South Africa. This shows the habitat; a collapse is not shown.

reservoir_storage_instability.alt: An aerial view of Lake Mead winding through dry, mountainous desert.
reservoir_storage_instability.caption: Lake Mead photographed from an aircraft in September 2012. This shows the reservoir setting, not its present storage or operating reliability.
reservoir_storage_instability.credit: Ken Lund from Reno, Nevada, USA

surface_water_storage_instability.alt: Aerial view of a low reservoir with broad exposed shoreline above nearby neighborhoods.
surface_water_storage_instability.caption: Anderson Reservoir in California at a low water level in April 2024. The shoreline shows one low-water condition, not the reservoir's full pattern of storage variability.

drinking_water_treatment_stress.alt: A treatment basin inside a building, with windows and stacks of supplies.
drinking_water_treatment_stress.caption: The interior of Krishnapuram water treatment plant. This shows treatment infrastructure; water quality and operational stress are not visible.

wastewater_infrastructure_overflow.alt: Rows of treatment basins and circular tanks at a large wastewater plant.
wastewater_infrastructure_overflow.caption: Blue Plains Advanced Wastewater Treatment Plant, Washington, DC, photographed from the air in 2025. This shows treatment infrastructure; overflow, bypass discharge and water reuse are not demonstrated.

dam_and_diversion_infrastructure.alt: A curved dam holds back dark water beside a river and a power building.
dam_and_diversion_infrastructure.caption: The hydroelectric dam at Hatfield, Wisconsin. This shows a river barrier and generating infrastructure, not a reliability trend.

cattle_stocking_density.alt: A herd of brown and black cattle stands on a dry pasture.
cattle_stocking_density.caption: Cattle grazing in eastern New Mexico. This shows the grazing setting; stocking density and soil compaction are not measured by the photograph.

pesticide_spray_drift_zones.alt: A tractor-mounted sprayer releases a mist among rows of orchard trees.
pesticide_spray_drift_zones.caption: A USDA photograph of pesticide spraying in an orchard. Spray is visible; movement beyond the treated area is not established.

deforestation.alt: A logging truck stands among cut trunks and tree stumps on a steep cleared slope.
deforestation.caption: A historic US Forest Service photograph of a clear-cut area in Siuslaw National Forest. The source does not establish the age of the harvested trees.
deforestation.credit: U.S. Forest Service- Pacific Northwest Region

forest_dieback_areas.alt: Many pale, dead conifers stand among surviving green trees.
forest_dieback_areas.caption: Spruce-beetle affected forest beside East Entrance Road in Yellowstone National Park. NPS documents beetle activity here in the late 1990s.

urban_sprawl_housing.alt: A broad grid of roads and densely built neighbourhoods seen from the air.
urban_sprawl_housing.caption: Phoenix, Arizona, photographed from an aircraft. This shows urban land cover, not the rate of its expansion.

wildfire_regime_shift.alt: Low flames and smoke spread between standing trees in a forest.
wildfire_regime_shift.caption: The lightning-caused Willard Fire, documented by the US Forest Service in 2014. This local event does not establish a fire-weather or fire-regime trend.

aviation_condensation_trails.alt: Several thin white and pink contrails cross a blue evening sky.
aviation_condensation_trails.caption: Aircraft condensation trails at sunset. The photograph records visible trails, not their warming effect.

pollinator_service_decline.alt: A honey bee rests among the stamens of a bright yellow cactus flower.
pollinator_service_decline.caption: A honey bee visits an Opuntia flower. This shows pollination activity, not colony collapse or a trend in insect abundance.

renewable_energy_deployment.alt: Rows of blue solar panels cover a sloping roof.
renewable_energy_deployment.caption: Photovoltaic panels on a roof in Nüziders, Austria. This illustrates a renewable electricity installation.

grid_scale_storage.alt: Rows of white battery enclosures occupy a fenced desert site.
grid_scale_storage.caption: The Desert Sunlight battery energy storage installation in Riverside County, California, photographed in 2022.
grid_scale_storage.credit: NextEra / Bureau of Land Management California

air_conditioning_refrigerants.alt: A technician works beside an open air-conditioning unit with service gauges visible.
air_conditioning_refrigerants.caption: A technician inspects a repaired air-conditioning unit in June 2024. Cooling equipment and service work provide context for refrigerant use; this photograph does not establish a leak or identify the refrigerant.
air_conditioning_refrigerants.credit: U.S. Air Force AFCENT by Airman 1st Class Derrick Bole

mining_critical_minerals.alt: Terraced benches descend into a large open-pit copper mine.
mining_critical_minerals.caption: Twin Buttes open-pit copper mine, Arizona, in a historic EPA DOCUMERICA photograph. This shows a mineral-extraction setting, not a current extraction-pressure measurement.

refinery_combustion_co2.alt: Orange flames rise from twin refinery flare stacks in daylight.
refinery_combustion_co2.caption: A flare burns at the Seria refinery in Brunei in December 2025. Combustion is visible, while its carbon-dioxide emission rate requires measurement.

coal_power_co2_output.alt: A yellow bulldozer pushes dark coal in a power-plant stockyard.
coal_power_co2_output.caption: A bulldozer moves coal at the Ljubljana heat and power plant, Slovenia, in winter 2017. This shows fuel handling; emissions and plant retirement are not shown.

data_centers.alt: Rows of server racks contain equipment, cables and indicator lights.
data_centers.caption: Wikimedia Foundation server racks. This illustrates physical computing infrastructure; AI workloads and energy consumption are not shown.

electric_vehicle_transition.alt: A person plugs a thick charging connector into the rear charging port of an electric car.
electric_vehicle_transition.caption: A driver connects a charging cable to an electric car. The photograph shows the everyday charging action involved in electric-vehicle use, rather than a charger standing on its own.

desalination_dependence.alt: A large coastal water-treatment complex has green roofs, storage pools and access roads.
desalination_dependence.caption: The Victorian Desalination Plant, Australia, photographed from the air. This shows the facility, not a community’s current dependence on desalinated water.

ecosystem_restoration.alt: People plant young trees in a prepared field.
ecosystem_restoration.caption: A documented Miyawaki tree-planting project at Hanji Farms, April 2017. This illustrates a restoration activity, not its eventual ecological or adaptation outcome.

alpine_snowpack_declines.alt: Patches of white snow cover an alpine basin below mountain slopes.
alpine_snowpack_declines.caption: Late-lying snow in Edith Basin, Mount Rainier National Park, August 2011. This records one place and date, not a snowpack trend.

jellyfish_swarm_surges.alt: Many translucent golden jellyfish float throughout blue-green water.
jellyfish_swarm_surges.caption: Hundreds of jellyfish in Jellyfish Lake, Palau. This records a natural aggregation, not a change in swarm frequency.

coastal_permafrost_erosion.alt: Exposed frozen-ground bluffs crumble below a tundra surface beside the Arctic coast.
coastal_permafrost_erosion.caption: An actively eroding coastal permafrost bluff on Barter Island, Alaska, July 2018. USGS documents exposed permafrost and collapsing tundra at this site.

semiconductor_fabs.alt: Two technicians in protective clothing work among cleanroom equipment.
semiconductor_fabs.caption: NASA Glenn’s silicon-carbide growth facility and surface-analysis cleanroom. This shows semiconductor research equipment, not the footprint of a commercial fabrication plant.

tundra_shrubification_speeds.alt: A flowering tundra-rose shrub has bright yellow flowers and small green leaves.
tundra_shrubification_speeds.caption: Tundra rose, a low deciduous shrub photographed by the US Fish and Wildlife Service in Alaska, June 2017. This shows a shrub, not a rate of vegetation expansion.
tundra_shrubification_speeds.credit: L. Whitehouse / US Fish and Wildlife Service

irrigation_water_inefficiency.alt: Sprinklers spray water across rows of leafy crops.
irrigation_water_inefficiency.caption: Sprinkler irrigation at Leafy Greens in California’s Salinas Valley, June 2011. This shows water use; efficiency and the source of the water are not established.

climate_resilient_agriculture.alt: Young orchard trees grow in rows with small irrigation sprinklers.
climate_resilient_agriculture.caption: Micro-irrigation used to establish an almond orchard in Livingston, California, July 2015. This illustrates a water-management practice; whole-farm climate resilience is not measured.

rail_heat_buckling.alt: White-painted steel rails run along a railway track.
rail_heat_buckling.caption: White-painted rails on the Rhaetian Railway, Switzerland, during a documented trial to reduce heat deformation. Actual buckling is not shown.

freshwater_mussel_depletion.alt: A freshwater mussel is held for examination during fieldwork.
freshwater_mussel_depletion.caption: A US Fish and Wildlife Service biologist holds a monkeyface mussel from the St Croix River, 2013. This shows the species, not a depletion trend.
freshwater_mussel_depletion.credit: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service - Midwest Region

feed_crop_dependency.alt: A combine harvester works in a mature rapeseed field beside a hedgerow.
feed_crop_dependency.caption: A combine harvester in a rapeseed field. This shows crop production; yield volatility and the destination of the harvested crop are not established.

industry_farming.alt: Large broiler chickens crowd around feed and water lines across the floor of a poultry house.
industry_farming.caption: Chickens fill an indoor poultry house in Zambraniyah, Iraq. The animal-level view shows high-volume poultry rearing; breeding methods and animal-health outcomes are not established by this photograph.

floodplain_exposure.alt: Floodwater covers a road between buildings and roadside vegetation.
floodplain_exposure.caption: A documented flash flood on Billesley Lane, England. This records local inundation, not a regional rainfall-intensity trend.

topsoil_salinization_fields.alt: A historic black-and-white photograph shows shallow water spread across agricultural fields.
topsoil_salinization_fields.caption: Fields at Beit HaArava being flushed with Jordan River water to remove soil salts, May 1944. This documents a historical salt-management practice.

pollen_allergen_spikes.alt: A pollen cone grows among long green pine needles.
pollen_allergen_spikes.caption: A ponderosa pine pollen cone in Tuntorp, Sweden. This shows a pollen-producing structure, not an airborne-allergen spike.

compound_coastal_flooding.alt: Floodwater covers a city street between buildings at night.
compound_coastal_flooding.caption: Hurricane Sandy flooding on Avenue C in Manhattan, October 2012. The photograph records inundation; the relative contributions of rain, tide and surge are not separated.

urban_tree_canopy_loss.alt: Trees line a city street with brick buildings and a green tram track.
urban_tree_canopy_loss.caption: Street trees along Sarphatistraat, Amsterdam, October 2021. This shows urban vegetation, not a loss of canopy over time.

wetlands_drainage_scales.alt: A narrow drainage trench crosses dark peat and low vegetation.
wetlands_drainage_scales.caption: A drainage channel cut into peat, photographed in 2010. This shows physical drainage; oxidation and carbon release are not directly visible.

transmission_buildout_lag.alt: Steel electricity pylons carry lines across golden grassy hills under storm clouds.
transmission_buildout_lag.caption: High-voltage transmission lines cross a grassy valley. This shows grid infrastructure, not construction delays or peak-load stress.

mobile_wireless_networks.alt: Antennas are mounted at the top of a mobile communications mast.
mobile_wireless_networks.caption: A mobile-phone base station near the M25 in England, operated by EE and Three UK.

public_transit_expansion.alt: Passengers walk and sit beside an Elizabeth line train at a new underground station.
public_transit_expansion.caption: Passengers use London’s Elizabeth line on its opening day. This documents an addition to the public-transport network already carrying people.

bridge_scour_exposure.alt: A damaged footbridge crosses a creek after flooding.
bridge_scour_exposure.caption: A flood-damaged footbridge over Te Auaunga creek, Auckland, January 2023. The image does not establish scour as the damage mechanism.

agricultural_nitrogen_application.alt: An overhead view of a tractor applying dark parallel bands of slurry across a field through a wide spreading boom.
agricultural_nitrogen_application.caption: A tractor spreads slurry in East Lothian, Scotland, in May 2022. Livestock slurry supplies nitrogen and other nutrients to soil; the photograph shows application, not whether the dose exceeds crop needs.

topsoil_erosion_acceleration.alt: An erosion gully cuts through exposed soil.
topsoil_erosion_acceleration.caption: A photographed gully eroded into soil. This documents an erosion feature, not its rate of growth.

glacial_siltation_streams.alt: Braided glacial river channels spread across a broad outwash plain.
glacial_siltation_streams.caption: The Skeiðará River and glacial outwash plain seen from Skaftafell, Iceland, July 2014. This shows the sediment-transport setting, not a siltation rate.

fjord_sedimentation_pulses.alt: A tour boat passes a glacier face above fjord water.
fjord_sedimentation_pulses.caption: Holgate Glacier at the head of a fjord in Kenai Fjords National Park, Alaska. This shows a glacial-fjord setting, not a sedimentation pulse.

anaerobic_manure_lagoon_operation.alt: A concrete slurry pit with dark liquid is seen through a chain-link fence.
anaerobic_manure_lagoon_operation.caption: A slurry-storage pit at Carrigcleena, Ireland, photographed in June 2024. This shows manure-storage infrastructure; anaerobic activity and methane output are not visible.

livestock_disease_pressure.alt: Dozens of beef cattle stand together inside a fenced New Mexico feedlot.
livestock_disease_pressure.caption: Beef cattle in a New Mexico feedlot, photographed in 2024. The gathering of many animals is visible; this photograph does not diagnose disease or establish the drivers of animal-health risk.

oil_gas_flaring_co2.alt: A gas flare burns above a wellpad among trees in Mississippi.
oil_gas_flaring_co2.caption: Natural gas being flared at an oil wellpad in Liberty, Mississippi, in 2014. The flame shows gas combustion; the photograph does not quantify carbon dioxide output.

oil_power_co2_output.alt: Rows of green generating engines and tall exhaust pipes stand beneath a cloudy sky.
oil_power_co2_output.caption: The KM9 power station in Luanda, Angola, uses oil-derived diesel fuel. Rows of generating engines and exhaust stacks show the equipment behind this source of power-sector emissions.

arctic_shipping_expansion.alt: Scientists and crew pose on sea ice beside an icebreaker.
arctic_shipping_expansion.caption: Scientists and crew beside the icebreaker Healy during NASA’s ICESCAPE Arctic research voyage in July 2011. A documented Arctic research voyage; this photograph does not establish growth in shipping traffic.

passive_cooling_design.alt: A modern white house has deep projecting frames above tall windows, casting shade over the glass and seating area.
passive_cooling_design.caption: The built CRETE demonstration house at the 2017 Solar Decathlon in Denver. Large projecting gutters shade the windows while collecting rainwater, an example of limiting solar heat through building design.
passive_cooling_design.credit: Dennis Schroeder/US Department of Energy Solar Decathlon

pm2_5_particulates.alt: A woman holds an air-quality monitor beside smoke rising from burning roadside waste.
pm2_5_particulates.caption: Air-quality monitoring beside a burning roadside garbage dump near Mumbai, January 2020. The tiny particles cannot be identified by sight; the smoke and monitoring setting are visible.

wildfire_smoke_pm25_exposure.alt: Pedestrians cross a Manhattan street beneath a dense orange haze from wildfire smoke.
wildfire_smoke_pm25_exposure.caption: Smoke from Canadian wildfires envelops pedestrians at 42nd Street near Grand Central Terminal on 7 June 2023. The haze documents wildfire-smoke exposure; PM2.5 concentration requires measurements.
wildfire_smoke_pm25_exposure.credit: Marc A. Hermann / Metropolitan Transportation Authority

pyrocumulonimbus_smoke_injection.alt: A towering white and gray pyrocumulonimbus cloud rises above wildfire smoke in Australia.
pyrocumulonimbus_smoke_injection.caption: A pyrocumulonimbus cloud over Victoria, Australia, during the 2019–20 bushfires, photographed from an aircraft. The cloud is visible; the altitude or amount of smoke injected cannot be measured from this image.

riparian_zone_erosion.alt: An exposed, eroded riverbank beside flowing water and trees.
riparian_zone_erosion.caption: An eroded bank of the Nottawasaga River at Beattie Pinery Provincial Nature Reserve in April 2021. A documented riverbank; the rate and extent of erosion require site observations.

residential_gas_heat_co2.alt: A red burner is attached to a large silver heating boiler, with pipes and controls visible.
residential_gas_heat_co2.caption: A gas-fired condensing boiler heats a multi-unit apartment building in White Rock, British Columbia, photographed in 2006. The equipment provides residential-heating context; fuel use determines its carbon dioxide output.

climate_litigation_pressure.alt: Older women carry a KlimaSeniorinnen banner reading “Don’t blow it! Good planets are hard to find” at a climate march.
climate_litigation_pressure.caption: KlimaSeniorinnen campaigners at a climate demonstration in Bern. The Swiss association brought the climate case decided by the European Court of Human Rights in 2024; this photograph shows public advocacy, not a court hearing.

road_stream_crossing_barriers.alt: A stream flows from a concrete culvert through dense vegetation.
road_stream_crossing_barriers.caption: Brookfield Stream flows from a culvert in Albany, Auckland, photographed in November 2024. A documented stream crossing; its effects on fish passage require site-specific evidence.

rail_diesel_co2.alt: A blue-and-yellow diesel locomotive stands beside other locomotives.
rail_diesel_co2.caption: A DF4D diesel locomotive at Liuzhou Locomotive Depot, China, in June 2016. A documented diesel locomotive; fossil CO₂ output requires fuel-use accounting.

diesel_freight_co2.alt: A large articulated freight truck fills the foreground of a highway, with another truck ahead.
diesel_freight_co2.caption: Heavy freight trucks travel along a highway. Road haulage is shown as context for diesel-freight emissions; the photograph does not establish the fuel or emissions of an individual vehicle.

fertilizer_production.alt: A fertilizer-production plant with buildings, pipework and industrial structures.
fertilizer_production.caption: The Yara Belle Plaine fertilizer plant in Saskatchewan, photographed in February 2021. A documented fertilizer-industry site; production pathways and present emissions require separate evidence.

amphibian_chytrid_fungus_spreads.alt: A small tree frog with an inflated vocal sac clings to a green stem.
amphibian_chytrid_fungus_spreads.caption: A male tree frog calling in the wild at night, photographed in May 2010. A documented wild amphibian; infection, genetics and range contraction are not diagnosed from appearance.

gas_power_co2_output.alt: Three tall exhaust stacks rise above the generating modules of Delimara power station.
gas_power_co2_output.caption: Gas-fired generating units at Delimara, Malta, photographed in 2019. The generating equipment is visible; carbon dioxide emissions themselves are not.

backup_generator_dependence.alt: A large generator occupies a city sidewalk beside shops during a power outage.
backup_generator_dependence.caption: Businesses in Auckland operated with diesel generators on the sidewalk during the 1998 power outage. The machines show the physical equipment needed when normal electricity supply fails.

hail_hazard_shift.alt: Dense cracks and impact marks cover almost the entire front windshield of a car.
hail_hazard_shift.caption: A car windshield shattered by the 4 July 2010 hailstorm at Limon, Colorado. The damage makes hail’s destructive potential visible; changing hazard patterns require a longer event record.

tropical_cyclone_rapid_intensification.alt: Clouds below a reconnaissance aircraft, with part of a propeller visible.
tropical_cyclone_rapid_intensification.caption: A view from a U.S. Air Force reconnaissance flight inside Hurricane Harvey, 24 August 2017. A documented hurricane reconnaissance flight; intensification rates require storm observations over time.
tropical_cyclone_rapid_intensification.credit: U.S. Air Force / Staff Sgt. Heather Heiney

ice_cap_decapitation.alt: An aerial view of glacier ice with crevasses and dark surface streaks.
ice_cap_decapitation.caption: An aerial photograph of Skeiðarárjökull, an outlet of Iceland’s Vatnajökull ice cap, in October 2008. Ice-cap context; one photograph does not establish loss of its accumulation area.

waste_incineration_co2.alt: Industrial buildings and a tall chimney at a waste-incineration plant.
waste_incineration_co2.caption: A waste-incineration plant in Bratislava, photographed in September 2021. A documented waste-incineration facility; fossil CO₂ output requires waste and fuel accounting.

inland_waterway_fuel_spills.alt: Brown river water beside a rocky urban riverbank.
inland_waterway_fuel_spills.caption: The New Orleans riverfront during an oil-spill cleanup in April 2018. A documented riverfront oil-spill cleanup; the photograph does not establish the spill source or present conditions.

weatherization_retrofits.alt: External insulation boards cover parts of an apartment building facade.
weatherization_retrofits.caption: External polystyrene insulation being installed on a building in Warsaw in August 2025. Building-insulation context; energy savings and weatherization performance require evaluation.

invasive_species_encroachment.alt: Dense green kudzu vines cover much of a two-storey brick building and spill over its roofline.
invasive_species_encroachment.caption: Kudzu climbs over a derelict brick building in Cairo, Illinois, in 2020. The invasive vine’s dense growth makes its capacity to engulf surrounding structures visible.

lightning_regime_shifts.alt: Lightning forks across a dark purple sky above a silhouetted landscape.
lightning_regime_shifts.caption: Lightning during a thunderstorm near Pritzerbe, Germany, in September 2010. A documented thunderstorm; one photograph does not establish lightning density or seasonal change.

low_cloud_deck_retreat.alt: Low coastal clouds fill a basin below wooded mountain slopes.
low_cloud_deck_retreat.caption: A coastal marine layer fills the Los Angeles Basin, photographed from Mount Wilson in May 2026. Marine-cloud context; one photograph does not establish a decline in cloud cover.

avian_migration_disruptions.alt: A large flock of geese flies above a field and a distant tree line.
avian_migration_disruptions.caption: Migrating snow geese at Kulm Wetland Management District, photographed in March 2015. Documented migratory birds; timing, route changes and stopover disruption require observations over time.

nunatak_habitat_shrinkage.alt: An archival aerial photograph of a rocky nunatak surrounded by glacier ice.
nunatak_habitat_shrinkage.caption: Columbia Glacier and Great Nunatak, Alaska, photographed from the air by Austin Post in September 1966. Exposed mountain-and-ice habitat context; the photograph does not establish habitat contraction.

deepwater_petroleum_spill_risk.alt: Smoke and flames rise from an offshore drilling rig as vessels spray water.
deepwater_petroleum_spill_risk.caption: Vessels respond to the Deepwater Horizon rig fire in the Gulf of Mexico in April 2010. A documented offshore accident; current risk and operations require site-specific evidence.

oil_building_heat_co2.alt: A waste-oil boiler with pipework, pressure gauges and an expansion tank.
oil_building_heat_co2.caption: A U.S. Air Force waste-oil boiler system providing hot water for remote operating locations in 2023. Oil-heating equipment context; fossil CO₂ output requires fuel-use accounting.

wetland_peat_fires.alt: Smoke seeps from blackened ground around damaged trees and exposed roots in a peatland.
wetland_peat_fires.caption: Smoke rises from peat soils during the Lateral West Fire at Great Dismal Swamp National Wildlife Refuge, Virginia, August 2011. The fire burned below the surface as well as through vegetation.
wetland_peat_fires.credit: Chris Lowie / U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service

personal_conveyance.alt: Cars queue at a traffic signal on an urban road.
personal_conveyance.caption: Cars waiting at a traffic signal in Kiyovu, Kigali, photographed in March 2020. Road-vehicle context; fuel type, travel demand and fossil CO₂ output require separate evidence.

wet_bulb_heat.alt: A weather observer in uniform holds a red and black wet-bulb heat monitor outdoors.
wet_bulb_heat.caption: A Marine weather observer reads a wet-bulb globe temperature monitor in Yuma, Arizona, in August 2010. The instrument assesses combined heat stress; this photograph does not establish a regional heat trend.
wet_bulb_heat.credit: Lance Cpl. Aaron Diamant / U.S. Marine Corps

agricultural_labor_exposure.alt: A line of farm workers bends over crops in a California field beneath a cloudy sky.
agricultural_labor_exposure.caption: Farm workers in a field near Nipomo, California, in August 2016. The photograph shows outdoor agricultural labor; it does not measure heat stress, safety conditions or harvest losses.

farm_heat_stress.alt: A farm worker gathers rice beside a flooded field under an open sky in Madagascar.
farm_heat_stress.caption: A farm worker handles a rice harvest near Antananarivo, Madagascar, in March 2025. The photographer reports temperatures above 36 °C; the image does not measure this worker's heat exposure or lost labor hours.

occupational_heat_exposure.alt: A construction worker in a fluorescent vest, helmet and visor stands amid equipment at a Hong Kong work site.
occupational_heat_exposure.caption: A construction worker at a Hong Kong site during a June 2025 heatwave. The protective clothing and work setting are visible; the worker's personal heat dose or health outcome is not.

rice_paddy_methane_bubbles.alt: Farm workers bend over rows of seedlings in a flooded rice field.
rice_paddy_methane_bubbles.caption: Rice seedlings being planted by hand in flooded fields in Sabae, Japan, in 1985. Flooded rice-field context; methane production and release require measurements.

savannah_tree_cover_decline.alt: Trees and grasses spread across an open savanna landscape.
savannah_tree_cover_decline.caption: Savanna at Sabi Sand Private Game Reserve, South Africa, photographed in March 2019. Open savanna context; tree-cover decline requires observations over time.

multi_hazard_early_warning.alt: A leader with a megaphone guides children carrying emergency supplies along an evacuation route.
multi_hazard_early_warning.caption: A leader uses a megaphone as children practise a tsunami evacuation route at Futenma, Okinawa, February 2026. This shows the communication and response component of an early-warning system.
multi_hazard_early_warning.credit: U.S. Marine Corps photo by Pfc. Dulce Alvarez Lemus

cloud_albedo_shift.alt: Photographed storm clouds rise over Earth, with the curved horizon visible.
cloud_albedo_shift.caption: Thunderheads near Borneo, photographed by the ISS Expedition 40 crew in August 2014. Cloud context; moisture, storm energy and circulation changes require observations over time.

subsea_cables.alt: A cable-laying ship at sea, with its deck equipment visible.
subsea_cables.caption: Cable ship Global Sentinel laying a submarine cable system in February 2008. Cable-laying context; the photograph does not establish landing-site concentration or current service disruption.

fast_fashion.alt: Rows of workers and production tables fill a long garment factory, with fabric being handled in the foreground.
fast_fashion.caption: Workers on a garment assembly line in Bangladesh. This shows the production setting behind clothing supply chains; the photograph alone does not establish a particular brand’s turnover speed or labour conditions.

transformer_heat_failure_risk.alt: An outdoor electrical transformer with cooling panels and pipework.
transformer_heat_failure_risk.caption: An electrical substation transformer on Love Lane, Liverpool, in September 2012. A documented transformer; heat failure and supply bottlenecks require operational evidence.

groundwater_depletion_wells.alt: A capped borehole with a pipe leading to it on bare ground.
groundwater_depletion_wells.caption: A drilled water source on a construction site in Awka, Nigeria, photographed in April 2026. Groundwater-access context; pumping rates, recharge, water levels and salinity require monitoring.

stratospheric_cooling.alt: Two researchers prepare a large white weather balloon outdoors.
stratospheric_cooling.caption: NOAA researchers launch a weather balloon. Weather-observation context; atmospheric chemistry, temperatures and circulation patterns are established by measurements.

food_insecurity.alt: People gather around bags of wheat flour at a food-aid distribution site in Pakistan.
food_insecurity.caption: Wheat flour being distributed at a camp in Bannu, Pakistan, in 2014. Food assistance is one response to insecure access; the photograph does not establish any recipient's current food status.

humanitarian_surge_demand.alt: Rows of sleeping mats fill a large emergency shelter used during Bangkok flooding.
humanitarian_surge_demand.caption: An emergency shelter at Rajamangala Stadium during the 2011 Bangkok floods. It shows people receiving temporary shelter, not the scale of unmet humanitarian need.
humanitarian_surge_demand.credit: Cpl. Robert J. Maurer / U.S. Marine Corps

sea_level_rise.alt: Seawater covers part of a coastal road near houses and parked vehicles in North Carolina.
sea_level_rise.caption: King-tide water crossing a road near Core Sound, North Carolina. A single tidal flood illustrates coastal exposure; it does not demonstrate a long-term rise in mean sea level.

vector_borne_disease_expansion.alt: Close-up of a black-and-white striped Aedes mosquito feeding on a person's skin.
vector_borne_disease_expansion.caption: An Aedes albopictus mosquito feeding on human skin, photographed for the CDC. The image identifies a disease-carrying mosquito; it does not show where its range or disease transmission has changed.

carbon_emission.alt: A tall power-plant stack rises above trees and releases a white plume into the sky.
carbon_emission.caption: A power-plant stack in Berlin with a visible plume, photographed in 2007. Carbon dioxide is invisible; this photograph shows a combustion facility, not the amount of CO₂ it emitted.

equitable_cooling_access.alt: People gather beside spraying water and mist at a public fountain during hot weather.
equitable_cooling_access.caption: People cool off at Berlin’s Lustgarten fountain during the June 2026 heatwave. A public water space provides shared relief from heat; this photograph does not measure access across the city.

utility_disconnection_risk.alt: A utility technician works at an outdoor electricity meter on a brick home.
utility_disconnection_risk.caption: A utility technician disconnecting residential electricity for nonpayment in Durham, North Carolina, in 2008. The photo shows one disconnection, not the household's later outcome or the overall risk rate.

ocean_acidification.alt: A translucent, spiral-shelled pteropod photographed close up against a black background.
ocean_acidification.caption: A pteropod specimen with worn shell ridges that NOAA describes as affected by ocean acidification. This close-up does not show seawater pH or the global trend.

biodiversity_intactness_loss.alt: A cleared hillside with tree stumps borders standing forest near a road in Oregon.
biodiversity_intactness_loss.caption: Clear-cutting next to forest identified as spotted-owl habitat in Oregon. The photograph shows habitat removal, one pressure on biodiversity; it does not measure the change in species abundance.
biodiversity_intactness_loss.credit: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service / National Conservation Training Center

energy_affordability_crisis.alt: A London protester holds a placard reading ‘Freeze prices not the poor’ with a call to renationalise gas and electricity.
energy_affordability_crisis.caption: A protester in London in February 2022 holds a sign calling for lower gas and electricity prices. The photo records concern about affordability, not any household's measured energy burden.

water_stress.alt: Children gather around a public tap with plastic water containers in Goma.
water_stress.caption: Children queue for clean water in Goma, Democratic Republic of the Congo, during a reported water shortage in 2023. This scene does not establish a regional water-stress score.

glacier_hydrologic_system_floods.alt: Bent metal bridge section on a rocky plain near Skaftafell, Iceland.
glacier_hydrologic_system_floods.caption: A twisted bridge section displayed near Skaftafell, Iceland, after the 1996 glacial-lake outburst flood. The flood itself is not shown.

old_growth_forest_logging.alt: Historical black-and-white photograph of dozens of people standing on an enormous felled sequoia stump.
old_growth_forest_logging.caption: People stand on the stump of the Mark Twain Tree, a giant sequoia felled in California in 1891. This historical photograph shows the scale of an old-growth tree removed by logging.
old_growth_forest_logging.credit: C. C. Curtis / National Park Service archive

drought_persistence.alt: A tilted wooden boat rests on an exposed muddy riverbank, with shallow water and barges beyond.
drought_persistence.caption: A boat sits stranded on the exposed shore at Santarém, Brazil, during the severe Amazon drought of October 2023. This documents drought impacts at one place and time; persistence requires observations over time.

migration.alt: Women and children beside a temporary shelter at a displacement camp in Somaliland.
migration.caption: Families at an internally displaced persons camp near Burao, Somaliland, during a drought and food crisis. The photograph shows displacement, not every form or cause of migration.

marine_heatwaves.alt: Reef covered in vivid pink, yellow, blue, and pale corals during a bleaching event.
marine_heatwaves.caption: Heat-stressed corals showing vivid colors during a bleaching event in the Philippines. Coral response is visible; a marine heatwave threshold requires temperature records.

plastics_petrochemicals.alt: Mount Fuji rises behind a broad industrial belt with refinery towers and power-station chimneys.
plastics_petrochemicals.caption: Japan's Keiyo industrial belt, with chemical plants, an oil refinery, and an LNG power station below Mount Fuji. The photograph shows the industrial setting; it does not identify emissions from individual facilities.

urbanization.alt: Aerial view of dense suburban housing blocks, roads, and green spaces in Chandler, Arizona.
urbanization.caption: An aerial view of the sprawling neighborhoods of Chandler, Arizona, in 2007. A single photograph shows the urban form, not the pace of urban growth.

coal_retirement.alt: Dust rises around three tall smokestacks as one collapses during the demolition of a retired coal power plant.
coal_retirement.caption: The smokestacks of the retired Navajo Generating Station near Page, Arizona, are imploded in December 2020, after the coal-fired plant shut down.

clean_electricity.alt: Rows of solar panels spread across fields with two wind turbines rising beyond them.
clean_electricity.caption: An aerial view of Westmill Solar Farm, with wind turbines behind it, in the United Kingdom. The photograph shows renewable generation infrastructure.
clean_electricity.credit: MrRenewables / Westmill Solar Co-operative / Neil Maw

steel.alt: Bright molten steel and flames fill a ceramic casting mold against a dark foundry background.
steel.caption: Molten steel is poured into a ceramic shell during investment casting. This close-up shows one steel-casting process, not the scale of steel production or its emissions.

heat_pump_electrification.alt: A technician checks gauges and coloured hoses connected to a large outdoor heat pump.
heat_pump_electrification.caption: A technician works on an outdoor heat-pump unit with gauges and service hoses attached. Heat pumps use electricity to transfer heat for buildings.
heat_pump_electrification.credit: Vernon Air Conditioning, Plumbing & Electrical Services

forest_fragmentation.alt: Pale winding logging roads and clearings divide dark green forest on steep hillsides.
forest_fragmentation.caption: Logging tracks and cleared strips cut through forest in Marlborough, New Zealand, in 2006. These openings show how continuous tree cover can become divided.
forest_fragmentation.credit: Phillip Capper from Wellington, New Zealand

ice_sheet_mass_loss.alt: Numerous vivid blue lakes and branching meltwater channels cross a white ice sheet.
ice_sheet_mass_loss.caption: Blue meltwater lakes and channels on the Greenland Ice Sheet, photographed from an aircraft in July 2014. Surface melting is visible; the total change in ice-sheet mass requires measurements.

food.alt: Cattle cast long shadows across fenced feedlot pens stretching toward farm buildings and the horizon.
food.caption: Cattle held in a feedlot south of Portales, New Mexico, in October 2024. This is one livestock-production setting behind agricultural demand; the photograph does not measure consumption or animal health.

ice_albedo_feedback_loops.alt: A researcher in a red suit carries light-measuring instruments across white sea ice between dark meltwater pools.
ice_albedo_feedback_loops.caption: Don Perovich measures reflected sunlight among melt ponds on Chukchi Sea ice during NASA’s ICESCAPE mission in July 2011. The contrast between bright ice and darker water helps explain the ice-albedo feedback.

ai_data_centers.alt: Rows of black Summit computer cabinets with blue panels stretch across a brightly lit machine room.
ai_data_centers.caption: Summit supercomputer at Oak Ridge National Laboratory, 2018. Scientific computing infrastructure used for AI research; its energy and water footprint is not visible here.

aviation.alt: A four-engine cargo aircraft lifts above the runway with its landing gear still extended.
aviation.caption: An Atlas Air Boeing 747 freighter takes off from Hong Kong, October 2018.

flood_resilient_infrastructure.alt: A curved metal flood barrier separates high river water from a dry street beside buildings.
flood_resilient_infrastructure.caption: A temporary flood barrier holds back high river water at Ironbridge, England, in 2022. The dry street on the protected side makes the barrier’s function visible.

bark_beetle_epidemics.alt: Bare spruce trunks and cleared patches cover hillsides, with a surviving stand at the right.
bark_beetle_epidemics.caption: Damaged spruce forest near Bad Harzburg, Germany, October 2022. The photographer documents bark-beetle damage in forests stressed by a changing climate.

insect_biomass_decline.alt: An entomologist stands beside a white mesh insect trap surrounded by dense green forest.
insect_biomass_decline.caption: An entomologist with a Malaise insect-sampling trap in Tanzania’s Udzungwa Mountains, 2014. Monitoring provides evidence about insects; this photograph does not establish a decline.

biodiversity_corridors_disruption.alt: An aerial view shows a green wildlife crossing joining forest on either side of a divided motorway.
biodiversity_corridors_disruption.caption: Kolu wildlife crossing over the Tallinn–Tartu highway in Estonia, September 2021. A response to the habitat barriers created by roads.

peatland_degradations.alt: A broad brown peat stockpile sits behind water, with a line of slender trees in the background.
peatland_degradations.caption: Extracted peat stockpiled beside water near the Karinskaya narrow-gauge railway in Russia, April 2012.

combined_sewer_overflow.alt: A yellow sewage-warning sign stands above a riverside wall, with water and overhanging branches below.
combined_sewer_overflow.caption: A Washington, DC, combined-sewer-outfall sign warns people to avoid river contact after rain, March 2011. The warning identifies a risk; an active sewage discharge is not shown.

agricultural_groundwater_withdrawal.alt: Water pours from a tubewell pipe into a concrete irrigation channel beside a green crop field.
agricultural_groundwater_withdrawal.caption: An electrically powered tubewell supplies an irrigation channel beside crops in Gujarat, India, in 2015. The flowing water and adjacent field show groundwater being withdrawn for agriculture.

cement_kiln_fuel_co2.alt: Steel towers, ducts, conveyors and platforms rise above a cement plant against a blue sky.
cement_kiln_fuel_co2.caption: Cement-kiln tower at Union Bridge, Maryland, September 2013. Context for cement production’s fuel demand; the photograph does not measure combustion emissions.

aviation_jet_fuel_co2.alt: A fuel truck is parked beside an airliner on an airport apron.
aviation_jet_fuel_co2.caption: An Airlink Embraer E190 is refuelled at Saint Helena Airport before a flight to Johannesburg, March 2020.

shipping_bunker_fuel_co2.alt: A small bunker vessel sits alongside a towering cruise ship in a harbour.
shipping_bunker_fuel_co2.caption: The bunker barge Convenant supplies fuel to MSC Preziosa in Hamburg, April 2019.

road_freight_diesel_lock_in.alt: Two white heavy trucks, one hauling a box trailer and the other an open trailer, travel beside each other.
road_freight_diesel_lock_in.caption: Two heavy trucks carry freight side by side on a highway. They illustrate road-freight infrastructure and vehicle investment; dependence on diesel is a system-level issue, not something the photograph measures.

airport_climate_exposure.alt: A jet stands in deep muddy floodwater beside airport hangars.
airport_climate_exposure.caption: Floodwater surrounds an aircraft at Chesterfield Airport near St. Louis during the 1993 floods.

coral_larval_mortality.alt: Small pale bundles released by coral float upward through dark water.
coral_larval_mortality.caption: Coral spawning in Flower Garden Banks National Marine Sanctuary, August 2005. This reproductive stage provides context for larval survival; mortality is not shown.

phytoplankton_decline.alt: Green microscopic algal cells appear against a pale background.
phytoplankton_decline.caption: Light microscopy of the microalga Tetraselmis suecica in a non-motile stage, January 2022. A close view of phytoplankton, not a measurement of population decline.

levee_and_channelization_works.alt: A river runs between concrete banks beneath a large dam.
levee_and_channelization_works.caption: The engineered river channel below Hracholusky Dam on the Mže River, Czechia, June 2023.

monsoon_volatility.alt: A curtain of rain crosses Grand Canyon beneath golden storm clouds and a partial rainbow.
monsoon_volatility.caption: Monsoon rain and a partial rainbow over Grand Canyon, August 2024. A monsoon storm provides context; changes in monsoon timing and reliability require longer records.

extreme_precipitation_intensity.alt: A woman wades through deep water beside a vehicle in a rain-soaked street.
extreme_precipitation_intensity.caption: A resident wades along a flooded Chennai street during the October 2008 monsoon, after a week of heavy rain. This documents a local rainfall event and its consequences.

carbon_dioxide_removal.alt: A young pine seedling stands in freshly disturbed soil on a dry hillside.
carbon_dioxide_removal.caption: Reforestation in Custer Gallatin National Forest, Montana, 2022. Planting trees can contribute to carbon removal as they grow; this image does not quantify stored carbon.

coral_reef_fragmentation.alt: A diver swims between branching coral nursery frames suspended above a pale seafloor.
coral_reef_fragmentation.caption: A diver visits a coral nursery in Florida Keys National Marine Sanctuary, August 2014. Growing fragments for restoration is a response to damaged reef habitat.

marine_food_web_simplification.alt: A tiny translucent pink krill rests across the tip of a human finger.
marine_food_web_simplification.caption: A krill on a fingertip, photographed for NOAA in May 2010. This small crustacean illustrates a marine food-web organism; food-web simplification is not directly visible.

humanitarian_response_funding_shortfall.alt: Staff stand among stacked sacks and boxes inside a large aid-supply tent.
humanitarian_response_funding_shortfall.caption: Aid supplies in a Dadaab warehouse, June 2012. Oxfam published this photograph while documenting funding shortfalls threatening essential services.

wildfire_smoke_exposure_duration.alt: A masked cyclist rides past traffic under dense orange-brown haze in Times Square.
wildfire_smoke_exposure_duration.caption: A masked cyclist travels through Times Square under Canadian wildfire smoke on 7 June 2023. This shows exposure in daily life during the episode; exposure duration requires observations over time.

freshwater_ecosystem_collapse.alt: Dead fish and birds lie on grass beside a park lake.
freshwater_ecosystem_collapse.caption: Dead fish and waterbirds collected beside Bonn’s Rheinauesee, June 2018. The source documents deaths during low-oxygen conditions and interacting stresses in this shallow lake.

ocean_heat_content.alt: Two people in hard hats and life jackets lower an orange ocean-measuring float from a ship into the open sea.
ocean_heat_content.caption: NOAA affiliates deploy a Deep SOLO Argo float from the R/V Kaʻimikai-O-Kanaloa in 2018. These instruments measure temperature through the ocean’s depths, providing observations used to assess stored heat; one deployment does not show a heat-content trend.

zoonotic_disease_outbreaks.alt: A black-and-white electron micrograph shows rounded influenza virus particles.
zoonotic_disease_outbreaks.caption: Transmission electron micrograph of influenza A virus from the CDC, 1981. A real microscopic photograph, providing context for zoonotic influenza risk rather than documenting a current outbreak.

cold_chain_failure_risk.alt: A person places labelled vaccine cartons on the shelves of an open medical refrigerator.
cold_chain_failure_risk.caption: COVID-19 vaccines are loaded into a refrigerator at Joint Base Langley-Eustis in January 2021. The temperature-sensitive stock makes the stakes of refrigeration failure tangible; this delivery is routine handling, not a documented failure.

fishery_protein_dependence.alt: Women sit beside fish offered for sale on a sandy waterfront with boats and people beyond.
fishery_protein_dependence.caption: Women sell fish at the waterfront market in Nouakchott, Mauritania, March 2012. A setting where fisheries support food and livelihoods.

humanitarian_resource_gaps.alt: A woman addresses a large seated group waiting at an outdoor food distribution point.
humanitarian_resource_gaps.caption: A community worker speaks with women waiting for food rations in Epworth, Harare, April 2009. A documented aid-distribution setting; the photo does not measure today’s resource gap.

disaster_recovery_inequality.alt: An excavator tears down a damaged house amid piles of debris and broken timber.
disaster_recovery_inequality.caption: A severely damaged home is demolished in Port Sulphur, Louisiana, after Hurricane Katrina in 2005. Recovery support and demolition decisions provide context for unequal recovery experiences.

managed_retreat_pressure.alt: A row of cottages ends abruptly above a steep white cliff and a stony beach.
managed_retreat_pressure.caption: Cottages stand at the eroding cliff edge at Birling Gap, England, May 2015, after another house was removed.

critical_infrastructure_fragility.alt: A broken bridge span sags into a river between two intact supports, interrupting the crossing.
critical_infrastructure_fragility.caption: A section of Dresden’s Carola Bridge lies collapsed in the Elbe on 11 September 2024, severing tram and pedestrian connections and district-heating pipes. This documents infrastructure failure; the collapse preceded the subsequent flood.

emergency_response_overload.alt: A crowd watches wooden fishing boats being carried on a truck through a town.
emergency_response_overload.caption: Fishing boats from Vady, Kollam, are transported for flood rescue in Chengannur during Kerala’s August 2018 floods. Mobilising community boats illustrates additional response capacity, not a measured overload.

urban_heat_action_plans.alt: A window sign announces an NYC cooling centre in several languages.
urban_heat_action_plans.caption: A multilingual cooling-centre sign at Briarwood Library in Queens, July 2018. An example of directing residents to heat relief; the photograph does not establish opening hours.

public_health_heat_burden.alt: Children and adults gather around large blocks of ice on a city sidewalk in a black-and-white photograph.
public_health_heat_burden.caption: Children seek relief from heat by licking blocks of ice in a Bain News Service photograph, circa 1910. Historical context for urban heat exposure; no illness is diagnosed here.

soil_moisture_collapse.alt: Deep cracks divide pale dry soil around isolated tufts of green grass.
soil_moisture_collapse.caption: Dry, cracked soil among grass in Fairfax County, Virginia, April 2018. Visible drying provides context for soil-moisture stress, not a quantified threshold.

watershed_forest_loss.alt: Large cleared patches interrupt conifer forest across rolling hills in a river valley.
watershed_forest_loss.caption: Clear-cut areas in Oregon’s Lewis and Clark River valley, April 2013. A stitched photographic panorama of forest removal within a watershed.

methane.alt: A damaged industrial gas-well site and pipes occupy a bare hillside.
methane.caption: Aerial view of the Aliso Canyon gas-leak site, December 2015, photographed by Earthworks. Methane itself is invisible in this ordinary photograph.

tundra_methane_outgassing.alt: Clusters of white bubbles are frozen at different depths in dark clear lake ice.
tundra_methane_outgassing.caption: Methane bubbles trapped in Alaskan lake ice, photographed by USGS scientist Miriam Jones. The publisher documents methane production as thawed organic material decays.

genetic_diversity_bottlenecks.alt: Two tiny black-footed ferret kits are held gently in blue-gloved hands.
genetic_diversity_bottlenecks.caption: Three-week-old offspring of the cloned black-footed ferret Antonia are held by conservation staff in 2024. This genetic-rescue programme introduces previously unrepresented genes into a population descended from only seven founders; genetic diversity cannot be judged from appearance.
genetic_diversity_bottlenecks.credit: Adrienne Crosier / Smithsonian’s National Zoo and Conservation Biology Institute

deforestation_co2_release.alt: An aerial view shows a broad clearing of felled and burned trees beside a standing forest.
deforestation_co2_release.caption: Cleared and burned land beside surviving forest in the Iquiri National Forest area, Amazonas, Brazil, in 2019. The clearing shows the loss of forest biomass; carbon dioxide emissions are not visible.

riverine_habitat_fragmentation.alt: A weir and power station span a blue river, dividing its upstream and downstream reaches.
riverine_habitat_fragmentation.caption: Aerial photograph of the weir and hydroelectric power station at Hausen, Germany, March 2022. River-spanning structures can interrupt aquatic habitat connectivity.

fossil_power_backup_co2.alt: An electrician leans over a large generator engine at a hospital.
fossil_power_backup_co2.caption: A U.S. Navy electrician inspects a hospital generator in Utuado, Puerto Rico, after Hurricane Maria in September 2017. It provides documented disaster-response context for reliance on backup power.
fossil_power_backup_co2.credit:
Official U.S. Navy Page from United States of America

GM1 Jonathan Eddy/U.S. Navy

internet_exchange_points.alt: Tall rows of labelled DE-CIX server cabinets and cables fill a data facility.
internet_exchange_points.caption: DE-CIX server racks at an internet exchange. These facilities connect separate networks; the photograph shows equipment rather than an outage.

glacier_meltwater_dependency.alt: A broad debris-covered glacier winds between steep snowy peaks and dark rocky slopes.
glacier_meltwater_dependency.caption: South Engilchek Glacier in Kyrgyzstan’s Tian Shan, August 2021. Glacial meltwater supports downstream water supplies; dependence is not measured by this photograph.

tidal_wetland_carbon_reversal.alt: Water channels cut between broken edges of low saltmarsh and exposed mud.
tidal_wetland_carbon_reversal.caption: Eroding saltmarsh at Tollesbury Fleet, England, January 2024. Habitat loss provides context for wetland carbon risk; carbon exchange is not directly visible.

lightning_fire_weather.alt: Pale smoke rises from a burning tree on a grassy slope among tall conifers.
lightning_fire_weather.caption: Smoke from the lightning-struck tree where Yosemite’s Pika Fire began, June 28, 2023, according to the photographer’s field account.

transformer_supply_bottleneck.alt: A huge transformer rests on a long specialised rail transport beside a passenger train.
transformer_supply_bottleneck.caption: A heavy transformer transport at Krauthausen, Germany, October 2017. Moving this equipment illustrates supply-chain logistics, not a measured shortage.

soil_microbial_depletion.alt: Gloved hands hold clear petri dishes with microbial colonies above bare soil.
soil_microbial_depletion.caption: Petri dishes containing microorganisms cultured from soil and water, August 2024. A view of microbial life, not evidence of depletion at this location.

agrochemical_water_sinks.alt: A farm worker sprays crops amid curved rows of vivid green shallots on terraced slopes.
agrochemical_water_sinks.caption: Spraying shallot crops to prevent pest attacks, December 2019. Pesticide application provides context for chemicals reaching waterways; runoff is not shown.

particulate_soot_levels.alt: A large blue-and-white ship trails a dark exhaust plume across a port.
particulate_soot_levels.caption: The vehicle carrier Autoracer emits dark exhaust in Le Havre, France, November 2014. Visible smoke provides combustion context; soot concentration requires measurement.

freeze_thaw_rock_fracturing.alt: A rock surface has split into angular fragments around a web of deep fractures.
freeze_thaw_rock_fracturing.caption: Freeze-thaw weathering of a rock in southern Iceland, photographed in August 1989.

nature_based_adaptation.alt: People arriving in small boats plant young mangroves in mud beside a tidal channel.
nature_based_adaptation.caption: People plant mangroves at Changkat Keruing, Malaysia, December 2024. Restoring coastal vegetation is one form of nature-based adaptation.

pollinator_colony_collapse.alt: A dense cluster of dead bees remains attached to a honeycomb.
pollinator_colony_collapse.caption: Dead honeybees on a comb after starvation during the long cold winter of 2005–06, according to the photographer. A documented colony loss; this is not identified as colony collapse disorder.

deep_sea_mining_dust.alt: Yellow-framed research instruments stand between deep furrows in the dark ocean floor.
deep_sea_mining_dust.caption: Research instruments inside old plough tracks at the DISCOL seabed-disturbance experiment in the eastern Pacific, September 2015. Context for mining-related sediment disturbance; an active commercial mining plume is not shown.

building_performance_standards.alt: A worker kneels beside instruments and wires inside a building under construction, lit red through the test enclosure.
building_performance_standards.caption: Daniel Bergey conducts an air-leakage test at NIST’s Net-Zero Energy Residential Test Facility, August 2011. Testing helps assess building performance; this image does not certify compliance.
building_performance_standards.credit: National Institute of Standards and Technology

peaker_plant_lock_in.alt: Several tall exhaust stacks rise above a brick power station on a riverbank.
peaker_plant_lock_in.caption: Kearny Generating Station across the Hackensack River, New Jersey, August 2010. A peaking-power site provides context for continued reliance on fuel-burning capacity.

crop_yield_volatility.alt: A field of maize has curled, dry brown leaves beneath green trees.
crop_yield_volatility.caption: Drought-stressed maize, July 2018. Visible crop stress provides context for harvest risk; yield volatility requires records across seasons.

fertilizer_price_shock.alt: Large white fertilizer bags are stacked beneath a tree beside farmland.
fertilizer_price_shock.caption: Bulk fertilizer bags in Burgundy, France, September 2012. These agricultural inputs provide context for price exposure; the photo does not show a price change.

ice_shelf_grounding_line_retreat.alt: A high pale ice cliff curves around dark blue water beside broken sea ice.
ice_shelf_grounding_line_retreat.caption: The ice front of Thwaites Glacier in West Antarctica, photographed for NASA. Context for the glacier system; the underwater grounding line and its movement are not visible.

coal_power_sulfur_emissions.alt: A blue-and-white power station with a tall stack and conveyor structures stands beside the sea.
coal_power_sulfur_emissions.caption: Point Aconi Generating Station, Nova Scotia, October 2017. A fuel-burning power station provides source context; sulfur-dioxide emissions are not visible or measured here.

urban_source_water_treatment_constraint.alt: Concrete treatment basins, walkways and pipes hold water beneath an open sky.
urban_source_water_treatment_constraint.caption: Coagulation and filtration facilities at a drinking-water treatment plant, photographed for the US EPA. Context for the infrastructure required to make source water usable, not evidence of a capacity failure.

construction_material_co2.alt: Workers tip a wheelbarrow of wet concrete and spread it between exposed steel reinforcing bars.
construction_material_co2.caption: Workers pour and spread concrete for a building floor. Cement production contributes to the embodied emissions of concrete; the photograph identifies the material and its use, not an emissions total or a low-carbon formulation.

el_nino.alt: A straight highway divides expanses of floodwater and sandy desert in an aerial view.
el_nino.caption: The Pan-American Highway crosses flooded ground in Peru’s Sechura Desert, documented by Peru’s Ministry of Defence during a coastal El Niño event. An impact photograph, not a measurement of the Pacific climate cycle.

la_nina.alt: Brown floodwater rushes across a street while people and bicycles stand near buildings beyond it.
la_nina.caption: Floodwater in Batticaloa, Sri Lanka, photographed in 2011. The photographer associates the flooding with the 2010–11 La Niña period; an individual flood has several contributing factors.

marine_pathogen_range_expansion.alt: A purple sea star lies on wet rocks with a damaged, disintegrating arm and exposed pale tissue.
marine_pathogen_range_expansion.caption: An ochre sea star on the Oregon coast has a disintegrating arm during sea star wasting disease. This documents a marine disease consequence; geographic expansion requires records across sites and time.

air_pollution_health_burden.alt: A schoolgirl holds an anti-pollution mask over her nose and mouth beside another child on a busy street.
air_pollution_health_burden.caption: Schoolgirls in Chittagong, Bangladesh, one wearing an anti-pollution mask, photographed in 2014. This documents a protective response to exposure, not a diagnosis of illness or a measured health burden.
air_pollution_health_burden.credit: Adam Jones from Kelowna, BC, Canada

demand_response.alt: An electronic road sign reads “Extreme heat — save power 4–9 pm — stay cool” above traffic.
demand_response.caption: A roadside sign in Los Angeles asks people to save electricity from 4–9 pm during the September 2022 heatwave. This is a call to reduce demand during peak hours; the photograph does not establish how much electricity was saved.

refrigerant_phase_down.alt: A technician wearing glasses works with his hands on refrigerant recovery equipment.
refrigerant_phase_down.caption: US Navy technician Janbari Hodge maintains a refrigerant recovery unit aboard USS George H.W. Bush, October 2014. Refrigerant handling provides context for reducing releases; the photo does not identify the gas or document a phase-down.

building_energy_efficiency.alt: A worker suspended by ropes fixes thick yellow insulation panels across the outside of a building.
building_energy_efficiency.caption: A rope-access worker installs exterior insulation on a building. The exposed insulating layer makes the energy-efficiency work visible before the final facade is applied.

tropospheric_ozone.alt: A green milkweed leaf bears dense dark stippling and discoloured patches among sunlit grass.
tropospheric_ozone.caption: Ozone injury on milkweed at Carl Sandburg Home National Historic Site, documented by the National Park Service. The discoloured leaf tissue makes an otherwise invisible air pollutant’s effects visible.

aquifer_recharge_failure.alt: A hydrologist in an orange shirt lays a bright yellow cable across dry, sparsely vegetated ground.
aquifer_recharge_failure.caption: USGS hydrologist Krishangi Groover lays survey cable at Fort Irwin, California, July 2019. The surveys assess groundwater conditions and recharge rates; this image shows the investigation, not a confirmed recharge failure.

ocean_salinity_stratification.alt: A technician in a yellow shirt prepares long cylindrical oceanographic instruments on a workbench aboard a research ship.
ocean_salinity_stratification.caption: Marine technician Sean Whelan prepares conductivity, temperature and depth instruments for the SPURS North Atlantic expedition, September 2012. These instruments investigate upper-ocean salinity structure; a stratification trend is not visible in the photograph.

water_reuse.alt: Rows of covered water-treatment basins and pipes extend toward distant trees.
water_reuse.caption: Treatment basins at the Tillman Water Reclamation Plant in Los Angeles, July 2023. Reclamation infrastructure prepares wastewater for further use.

planned_relocation.alt: Rows of new houses, some still under construction, stand on green coastal tundra beneath an overcast sky.
planned_relocation.caption: New housing photographed during a 2019 Senate visit documenting Newtok’s relocation to Mertarvik, Alaska, in response to coastal erosion.
planned_relocation.credit: Office of US Senator Lisa Murkowski

river_flow_regime_shift.alt: Shallow channels wind past exposed gravel and green riverbed beneath vineyard-covered hills.
river_flow_regime_shift.caption: Exposed riverbed at the confluence of the Nahe and Rhine during low water in August 2022. One low-flow episode provides context for changing river regimes.

reservoir_operating_shortfall.alt: Dozens of boats float in a small blue inlet surrounded by steep dry banks and an exposed anchor chain.
reservoir_operating_shortfall.caption: Boats sit below broad exposed banks at Lake Oroville, California, May 2021, when the reservoir was at about 38% of capacity.

hydropower_reliability_decline.alt: A broad dry reservoir bank slopes towards a small area of water crowded with moored boats.
hydropower_reliability_decline.caption: Drought exposes wide banks at California’s Lake Oroville, a hydropower reservoir. Low storage can constrain generation; this photograph does not establish a specific shutdown date.

snowmelt_timing_shift.alt: Fast dark water runs beneath an overhanging white snowbank in a mountain landscape.
snowmelt_timing_shift.caption: Snowmelt feeds high flows in Libby Creek, Wyoming’s Medicine Bow Mountains, July 2011. Context for the seasonal transfer of mountain snow into rivers.

flash_flood_regime.alt: Brown floodwater reflects desert mountains and white clouds across a normally dry valley.
flash_flood_regime.caption: Flash flooding fills parts of Panamint Valley beside California’s State Route 190, September 2013. An individual flood illustrates the hazard rather than a change in its frequency.

basin_treaty_breakdown.alt: People stand beside a broad muddy river while a long barrage crosses the water behind them.
basin_treaty_breakdown.caption: People gather beside Kotri Barrage on the Indus River in Pakistan, July 2017. Water-sharing infrastructure provides context for basin governance; no treaty breakdown is depicted.

ocean_current_regime_shift.alt: A ship’s crew in hard hats and life jackets prepares yellow instruments on an open deck.
ocean_current_regime_shift.caption: An Ocean Observatories Initiative team prepares an acoustic Doppler current profiler for deployment in the Argentine Basin. Such instruments measure currents used to study ocean circulation.
ocean_current_regime_shift.credit: OOI Coastal Global Scale Nodes program, Argentine Basin deployment team

pesticide_bioaccumulation_chains.alt: A low-flying plane releases a broad pale spray over a dark conifer forest.
pesticide_bioaccumulation_chains.caption: A plane sprays DDT during a spruce-budworm control operation near Yakima, Washington, in 1962. Historical pesticide release provides context for contamination moving through food webs.
pesticide_bioaccumulation_chains.credit: USDA Forest Service, Region 6 Forest Health Protection

hydrological_runoff_surges.alt: A red car moves through fast, turbulent floodwater at a street intersection at night.
hydrological_runoff_surges.caption: Flash-floodwater sweeps across a street in Cookeville, Tennessee, June 2013. Rapid accumulation and flow are visible at street level.

convective_instability_shift.alt: A weather-instrumented pickup sits beneath a massive, layered storm cloud.
convective_instability_shift.caption: A NOAA mobile weather station observes a sculpted supercell during the TORUS field campaign. Field measurements help investigate the conditions that produce severe storms.

coastal_saltwater_intrusion.alt: Bare dead mangrove trunks stand across exposed ground while a field worker surveys the site.
coastal_saltwater_intrusion.caption: A mangrove ghost forest in Puerto Rico, March 2019, documented by USDA as damaged by saltwater intrusion and acid-sulfate soils.
coastal_saltwater_intrusion.credit: Samuel Rios / USDA Natural Resources Conservation Service

polar_infrastructure_failure.alt: A drilling crew works on a narrow gravel road cut into a steep mountain slope.
polar_infrastructure_failure.caption: Crews drill beside Denali Park Road at Pretty Rocks in 2018 to assess the ice beneath the road. The work illustrates investigation of permafrost-related infrastructure hazards.

talik_expansion.alt: Two brown frozen sediment-core sections sit above a measuring ruler.
talik_expansion.caption: A frozen sediment core from Siberian permafrost. Taliks are unfrozen zones within permafrost terrain; this core provides material context rather than showing their expansion.

wildlife_habitat_patches.alt: A compact patch of trees sits between grassy hills and fenced open land.
wildlife_habitat_patches.caption: An Atlantic Forest fragment beside Cunha, São Paulo, Brazil. A small wooded patch amid open land illustrates the isolation of wildlife habitat.

waterborne_pathogen_outbreaks.alt: A health worker in a white protective gown and gloves performs a field diagnostic test at a treatment centre.
waterborne_pathogen_outbreaks.caption: Field epidemiologist Jean Robert performs a rapid cholera test at a treatment centre in Jérémie, Haiti, during the 2016 Hurricane Matthew response.

subsea_cable_landing_chokepoint.alt: People inspect an armoured black cable emerging from the sea onto a sandy beach.
subsea_cable_landing_chokepoint.caption: The Ifriqya submarine cable comes ashore at Ain Meriem, Bizerte, Tunisia. A landing point concentrates the infrastructure linking an undersea route to land.

fishery_border_dispute_zones.alt: Coast Guard personnel in a small boat approach a fishing vessel at sea.
fishery_border_dispute_zones.caption: US Coast Guard personnel approach a fishing vessel near Palau during a September 2022 fisheries patrol. Enforcement at sea provides context; this photo does not establish a disputed border.

early_warning_coverage_gaps.alt: A large yellow arrow and the words Evacuación Tsunami are painted on a market street.
early_warning_coverage_gaps.caption: A tsunami evacuation route is marked through the market in Tongoy, Chile. A visible local warning measure provides context for the importance of wider warning coverage.

heavy_metal_bioaccumulation.alt: A scientist wearing gloves and a broad-brimmed hat uses a net among water lilies.
heavy_metal_bioaccumulation.caption: An EPA scientist collects fish for mercury analysis in the Everglades, September 2014. Sampling helps track contaminants that can accumulate in aquatic food webs.

atmospheric_river_intensification.alt: Turbulent brown floodwater fills a rocky gorge beneath an arched concrete bridge.
atmospheric_river_intensification.caption: Floodwater surges beneath the Old Route 49 bridge on California’s South Yuba River during the January 2017 atmospheric-river event. One event illustrates the hazard, not a long-term trend.
atmospheric_river_intensification.credit: Kelly M. Grow/ California Department of Water Resources

coastal_aquifer_degradation.alt: A scientist aboard a small boat holds a water-quality instrument beside sampling tubes.
coastal_aquifer_degradation.caption: USGS scientist Christopher G. Smith measures water drawn from a seafloor groundwater well on the West Florida Shelf, June 2022. The work examines freshwater discharge and possible nutrient transport into coastal waters.

urban_heat_island.alt: An aerial view shows tightly packed urban blocks and glass skyscrapers extending across Milan.
urban_heat_island.caption: Dense buildings and paved surfaces in Milan, Italy. Urban form provides context for heat retention; this is an ordinary photograph, not a temperature map.

urban_distribution_water_loss.alt: Water spreads across a city intersection around traffic islands, buildings and vehicles.
urban_distribution_water_loss.caption: Water from a burst main floods the intersection of Therry and Victoria Streets in Melbourne, July 2019.

surface_water_inflow_deficit.alt: A closed paved boat ramp ends at an exposed rocky drop above a blue reservoir.
surface_water_inflow_deficit.caption: The Antelope Point launch ramp at Lake Powell ends above the water in August 2021. Low storage reflects the reservoir’s water balance, including inflow, evaporation and withdrawals.

surface_water_evaporative_loss.alt: A circular metal evaporation pan sits behind fencing beside a wind-measuring instrument.
surface_water_evaporative_loss.caption: An evaporation pan and weather instruments at Asprokremmos Reservoir, Cyprus. Such equipment measures conditions relevant to water lost from open surfaces.

surface_water_groundwater_exchange_shift.alt: Steaming water cascades over orange mineral-stained rock into a blue river.
surface_water_groundwater_exchange_shift.caption: Water from Excelsior Geyser’s hot spring system enters the Firehole River in Yellowstone. A visible example of groundwater feeding surface water, rather than evidence of a changing exchange rate.

land_carbon_sink_weakening.alt: Dead, bare tree trunks dominate a mountain forest, with fallen timber and patches of green regrowth.
land_carbon_sink_weakening.caption: Dead trees cover Großer Rachel in Bavaria, Germany. Forest mortality can reduce carbon uptake, although this scene alone does not establish the forest’s net carbon balance.

compound_day_night_heat_extremes.alt: A pharmacy’s illuminated thermometer displays 42°C beside a city building.
compound_day_night_heat_extremes.caption: A pharmacy sign reads 42°C during the July 2022 heatwave in Vitoria, Spain. This daytime scene illustrates heat exposure; compound day-and-night extremes require a temperature record.

north_atlantic_oscillation.alt: Large waves break beside black sand, steep green cliffs and offshore rock spires.
north_atlantic_oscillation.caption: Breaking waves at Reynisfjara on Iceland’s North Atlantic coast. Regional weather provides context for the North Atlantic Oscillation, whose phase cannot be inferred from this photograph.

pacific_north_american_pattern.alt: Smooth layered clouds hover above a snowy, pine-covered mountain ridge.
pacific_north_american_pattern.caption: Lenticular clouds over Colorado’s Front Range, photographed for NOAA. Atmospheric flow over western North America provides regional context; this is not a measurement of the Pacific–North American pattern.

quasi_biennial_oscillation.alt: A pale weather balloon rises into a blue sky filled with white clouds above a ship.
